item.boostermod.air_dash_upgrade.tooltip: Allows booster leggings to dash in midair.
item.boostermod.burrow_upgrade.tooltip: Look roughly downward and boost to burrow through breakable blocks.
Boosts straight upward instead of look direction.
item.boostermod.no_cooldown_upgrade.tool: Removes booster cooldown between successful boosts.
item.boostermod.random_impulse_upgrade.t: Randomizes boost impulse each time (does not affect burrow).
item.boostermod.boost_strike_upgrade.too: During boost and ~0.5s after: long reach and sticky targeting; melee deals full-charge damage in-window, with forced crits only when truly fully charged; swords wide-sweep. Hits stack attack power; kills stack more and reset booster cooldown (capped; clears when the buff expires). At full stacks, diamond sword or better is needed to one-shot zombies/skeletons. Boosting alone does not damage entities.
item.boostermod.charge_upgrade.tooltip: Hold Boost to charge; full charge overloads and can explode on impact.
item.boostermod.wall_break_upgrade.toolt: Boost through breakable walls along your flight path; costs health while inside walls.
